script.text: The time had finally come. As champion of the Duelist Kingdom Tournament, Yugi won the right to duel Maximillion Pegasus.
Promise me that you will free the souls of my grandfather and all the others.
Yes... but if I am the one that defeats you instead, you have to fulfill your end of the bargain as well. Take a close look at the card you hold in your hand, Yugi boy.
There's a reason why it's blank. For if I win, I claim your soul... forever!
You have much to gain, but much at risk as well.
It's a risk I'm willing to take to free the souls of my Grandpa and the others! But I don't plan to lose!
I hate to disappoint you, Pegasus, but I have no intention of ever becoming a part of your soul card collection.
